arguments.sql:
SELECT 'inv_journal_src' k, h."SRC_CD" a, count(*)::text b, min(h."SRC_REF") c, max(h."SRC_REF") d FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_srcref_eq_vend-invno', count(*)::text, sum(CASE WHEN h."SRC_REF"=trim(i."VEND_CD")||'-'||i."INV_NO" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::text, '', '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_journals_not_inv', count(*)::text, min(h."SRC_REF"), max(h."SRC_REF"), min(h."MEMO") FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='AP' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_date_vs_post', count(*)::text, sum(CASE WHEN i."INV_DT"=h."POST_DT" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::text, sum(CASE WHEN i."INV_DT">h."POST_DT" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO")
UNION ALL SELECT 'vend_cd_len', count(*)::text, min(length("VEND_CD"))::text, max(length("VEND_CD"))::text, min("VEND_CD") FROM "APVEND"
UNION ALL SELECT 'vend_sample', count(*)::text, min("VEND_NM"), max("VEND_NM"), '' FROM "APVEND"
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_date_before_inv', count(*)::text, '', '', '' FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_multi', count(*)::text, '', '', '' FROM (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY "INV_ID" HAVING count(*)>1) x
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_ids', min("INV_ID")::text, max("INV_ID")::text, count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH"
UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_ids', min("PAY_ID")::text, max("PAY_ID")::text, count(*)::text, '' FROM "APPAYM"
UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_neg_openstat', count(*)::text, '', '', '' FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0
UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_in_closed_unposted_period', count(*)::text, '', '', '' FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'gl_users', "SRC_REF", count(*)::text, '', '' FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' GROUP BY "SRC_REF"

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (2319,2320,2470,2471,1979,141,1075) OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_ID" IN (141,802)) ORDER BY 1,6
